_comment: Copy this file to ~/.config/pull-gate/config.json, or point PULL_GATE_CONFIG at it. Keys that start with an underscore are ignored. As shipped, paths are classified but nothing auto-merges, because both safe lists are empty.
_comment_safe_prefixes: Path prefixes that may be fast-forwarded without a person. Each must end with a slash. Example: ["reports/", "status/"]. List only files that are generated and never run. Empty means nothing auto-merges.
_comment_safe_repos: Repo directory names (the last part of the repo path) where auto-fast-forward is allowed at all. Example: ["alpha"]. A safe prefix in any other repo never merges on its own. Empty means nothing auto-merges.
_comment_exec_patterns: Regular expressions, case-insensitive, matched anywhere in the path. A match means the file executes or configures something that executes. It is never auto-merged, even under a safe prefix. These are a starting point, so add your own.
